The Opportunity

Every board Lumai builds has to run multi-gigabit links and feed high-current ASIC and FPGA rails. By month six, you will have signed off the critical channels on at least one board, built the model libraries and design guidelines the team reuses, and be the person whose analysis decides when a layout is ready to release.
